mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in a single month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% in a single month indicates a weakening labor market, which leads to reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances when the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances when RSAFS shows sustained growth.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a single month signals a contraction in supply, which leads to reduced corporate output and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 70% of the instances when the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 in a single month, combined with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.2%, signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 200,000 and UNRATE decreases > 0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% in a single month, combined with a decrease in real GDP (GDPC1) by more than 0.5% over the previous quarter, signals a weakening demand environment, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST decreases > 5% in 1 month and GDPC1 decreases > 0.5% in 3 months
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances when the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 0.5% in a single month signals inflationary pressure, which leads to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over three consecutive months signals strong supply-side growth, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances when INDPRO shows sustained growth.
